Food Safety Authority Acts Against E-commerce Platforms

The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has initiated action against several e-commerce platforms including Amazon, Swiggy, BigBasket, Zepto, and Flipkart. The specific nature of the action was not detailed in the provided coverage.
